reason: The escrow and the promo code are smart, but I'd be handing $500 to someone whose follower count and 'past results' are just self-reported. With Meta I can see cost per sale in my dashboard tomorrow; here I'm betting on a stranger's numbers.
objection: Will a creator post actually bring people through my door, or just likes from followers who don't even live in my city? Unverified follower counts make that worse, and a promo code only catches some of the customers anyway.
would_change_my_mind: Verified audience location and stats from Instagram, plus real promo-code redemption numbers from other local businesses like mine, so I could run one cheap test with a local creator and compare it to my Meta cost per customer.
